decision.rationale: I recommend declining this dispute because the carrier's record shows the goods were delivered. TXN-007978 (688.18 EUR, LARKSPUR GADGETS, card CRD-000242) posted on 2026-09-09. The dispute was opened on 2026-10-30, 51 days later, which is within the 120-day limit. The merchant's order confirmation DOC-000036 gives an expected delivery date of 2026-09-14. The dispute was opened 46 days after that date, so the 15-day waiting period had passed. The carrier's delivery confirmation DOC-000037 shows the parcel was delivered on 2026-09-14 to the cardholder's address in Bordeaux and signed for by V. Vidal. That matches the cardholder, Vera Vidal of Bordeaux (CH-000195). Under the proof-of-delivery rule, the goods are treated as received. Neither document contained an instruction to the bank.

proposed_actions.reason: The carrier's record shows your parcel was delivered to your address in Bordeaux on 2026-09-14, the expected delivery date, and was signed for by V. Vidal. Under our policy the goods are treated as received, so we cannot uphold this dispute.
